title: Construction of multi-bubble solutions for the energy-critical wave equation in dimension four
summary: For any $N\geq 2$, we construct a global solution of the energy-critical focusing wave equation in dimension four which blows up in infinite time at $N$ prescribed points $z_1,\ldots,z_N\in \mathbb R^4$, provided that the points form one orbit under a finite group of orthogonal symmetries. We denote by $c:=2\sum_{j\ne k}|z_j-z_k|^{-2}>0$ the corresponding interaction coefficient, which is independent of $k$.
